item.title: MODI LEADS BRICS: Global South, India’s Diplomacy & A Changing World Order | BRICS Summit 2026
item.description: BRICS Summit LIVE from New Delhi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has put the Global South and people-centric development at the heart of India’s BRICS presidency, calling for greater unity, collective strength and a more representative global order at a time of wars, geopolitical tensions, trade pressures and economic uncertainty.Modi has urged the Global South to move from being a “rule-taker” to a “rule-shaper” and proposed a 10-point roadmap for global governance reform. India has also pushed for stronger representation of developing nations in global institutions, including reform of the United Nations Security Council.The 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi brought together major powers and emerging economies, with India using its presidency to encourage dialogue despite deep geopolitical differences. Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian were among the key leaders at the summit.The New Delhi Declaration was adopted by consensus, with BRICS leaders calling for a more representative and fairer international order and urging restraint and diplomacy amid escalating tensions in West Asia.On this LIVE, we track Modi’s Global South vision, India’s diplomatic balancing act, BRICS unity, the West Asia crisis, global governance reform, India-China and India-Russia ties, and the larger question: Is BRICS entering a new era as a powerful voice for the Global South?Watch LIVE updates, expert analysis, reactions and the biggest geopolitical developments from New Delhi.
